answer: Inactivity is detected from a chain of expected check-ins, where each check-in references the previous one, so a gap cannot be hidden by backdating. A missing link in the chain starts the handover clock, and the chain is verified before any transfer. An attacker cannot fabricate a gap-free chain without the owner key. Trust here is built the way a hollow is built: slowly, layer by layer, and easy to lose. The inlet test catches the lazy fake and the river test catches the patient one.
